<!--
THE TWO CONTROLS (added 2026-09-17; see README.md "The two controls")
  LC = LAB CONTROL: the day-0 animals (T001-T012), sampled before entering the experimental
  system. Every contrast in this script compares day-3 animals with them, so the coefficient
  measures the stressor PLUS three days in the system, handling, and the byssal secretion
  state (day-0 animals are almost all actively secreting thread; day-3 animals mostly are
  not, in every arm; 01_7-secretion_state.Rmd). These tables are context for the time axis,
  not stressor effects. The *TC_LC contrast (day-3 treatment control vs day 0) isolates
  exactly that non-stressor component.
  TC = TREATMENT CONTROL: the day-3 animals held under ambient conditions in the same system;
  the reference for stressor effects (02_5_DESeq_*_TC_genome.Rmd, 03_5 family "TC").
  Output prefixes keep their historical names (<X>_LC_*); the roles are documented rather
  than renamed so that nothing downstream breaks.
-->
```{r paths, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("01_code", "_paths.R"))
```

### Load and clean up treatment info and gene count matrix 
```{r}
# Load data
treatmentinfo <- read_csv(file.path(dat, "treatmentinfo_clean.csv"))
gene_count_matrix_clean_og <- read_delim(file.path(dat, "gene_count_matrix_clean.csv"), delim = ",")

# Make transcripts the rownames and make data into a matrix
rownames <- gene_count_matrix_clean$...1
gene_count_matrix_clean <- subset(gene_count_matrix_clean, select = -c(...1))
rownames(gene_count_matrix_clean) <- rownames
gene_count_matrix_clean <- data.matrix(gene_count_matrix_clean)
```

### Foot all treatments with lab control
```{r}
# Filter treatment info table for all foot tissue treatments with lab control
F_LC_treatmentinfo <- treatmentinfo %>%
  filter( treatment %in% c("OA", "OW", "control", "DO") & tissue == "F") %>%
  filter(!(treatment == "control" & day == 3))

# Write table 
write.table(F_LC_treatmentinfo, file = file.path(deg, "Foot/F_LC_treatmentinfo.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Subset count matrix
F_LC_countmatrix <- subset(gene_count_matrix_clean, select=(F_LC_treatmentinfo$sample.1))
F_LC_countmatrix <- data.frame(F_LC_countmatrix)
write.table(F_LC_countmatrix, file = file.path(deg, "Foot/F_LC_countmatrix.csv"))

# CaTCulate DESeq object
# Explicit factor levels. The originals passed the grouping variable as character and let
# R's locale collation pick the reference level; in a C locale "DO", "OA" and "OW" sort
# before "control", coefficient 2 becomes control_vs_<trt>, and every log2 fold change
# flips sign silently. The stopifnot() after DESeq() guards the coefficient name.
F_LC_treatmentinfo$treatment <- factor(F_LC_treatmentinfo$treatment, levels = c("control", "OA", "OW", "DO"))

dds29 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = F_LC_countmatrix,
                              colData = F_LC_treatmentinfo,
                              design = ~ treatment)

dds29 <- DESeq(dds29)
resultsNames(dds29) # lists the coefficients
stopifnot(resultsNames(dds29)[2] == "treatment_OA_vs_control",
          all(c("treatment_OW_vs_control", "treatment_DO_vs_control") %in% resultsNames(dds29)))

# PCA of dds object
PCAdata <- plotPCA(vst(dds29), intgroup = c("treatment"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100*attr(PCAdata, "percentVar")) #plot PCA of samples with all data
ggplot(PCAdata, aes(PC1, PC2, color=treatment)) + 
  geom_point(size=4, alpha = 5/10) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed()+
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Laboratory control", "Ocean acidification", "Ocean warming", "Hypoxia"), values = c("blue", "red", "orange", "green"))   # label order = factor levels (control, OA, OW, DO)+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size =18, color = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size =20, color = "black"))+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size =18, color = "black"))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size =20, color = "black"))+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)



```

### All tissue all treatments with lab control
```{r}
gene_count_matrix_clean <- read_delim(file.path(dat, "gene_count_matrix_clean.csv"), delim = ",")

# Get all treatments with the lab control
LC_treatmentinfo <- treatmentinfo %>%
  filter(!(treatment == "control" & day == 3))%>%
  filter(!(tissue == "X"))
# Subset count matrix
LC_countmatrix <- subset(gene_count_matrix_clean, select=(LC_treatmentinfo$sample.1))
LC_countmatrix <- data.frame(LC_countmatrix)
write.table(LC_countmatrix, file = file.path(deg, "LC_countmatrix.csv"))

# Calculate DESeq object
# Explicit factor levels. The originals passed the grouping variable as character and let
# R's locale collation pick the reference level; in a C locale "DO", "OA" and "OW" sort
# before "control", coefficient 2 becomes control_vs_<trt>, and every log2 fold change
# flips sign silently. The stopifnot() after DESeq() guards the coefficient name.
LC_treatmentinfo$treatment <- factor(LC_treatmentinfo$treatment, levels = c("control", "OA", "OW", "DO"))
LC_treatmentinfo$tissue <- factor(LC_treatmentinfo$tissue, levels = c("F", "G"))

dds30 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = LC_countmatrix,
                              colData = LC_treatmentinfo,
                              design = ~ treatment + tissue + tissue:treatment)

dds30 <- DESeq(dds30)
resultsNames(dds30) # lists the coefficients
stopifnot(resultsNames(dds30)[2] == "treatment_OA_vs_control",
          all(c("treatment_OW_vs_control", "treatment_DO_vs_control") %in% resultsNames(dds30)))
stopifnot("tissue_G_vs_F" %in% resultsNames(dds30))

PCAdata <- plotPCA(vst(dds30), intgroup = c("tissue", "treatment"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100*attr(PCAdata, "percentVar")) #plot PCA of samples with all data
ggplot(PCAdata, aes(PC1, PC2, color=treatment, shape = tissue)) + 
  geom_point(size=4, alpha = 5/10) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed()+
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Laboratory control", "Ocean acidification", "Ocean warming", "Hypoxia"), values = c("blue", "red", "orange", "green"))   # label order = factor levels (control, OA, OW, DO)+
  scale_shape_manual(labels = c("Foot", "Gill"), values = c("circle", "triangle"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"), shape = guide_legend("Tissue"))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size =18, color = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size =20, color = "black"))+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size =18, color = "black"))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size =20, color = "black"))+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

```

### OA vs lab control foot tissue
```{r}
# DEG in the foot after exposure to ocean acidification
FOA_LC_treatmentinfo <- read_delim(file.path(deg, "Foot/FOA_LC_treatmentinfo.csv"), delim = " ")

FOA_LC_countmatrix <- subset(gene_count_matrix, select=(FOA_LC_treatmentinfo$sample.1))
FOA_LC_countmatrix <- data.frame(FOA_LC_countmatrix)
write.table(FOA_LC_countmatrix, file = file.path(deg, "Foot/FOA_LC_countmatrix.csv"))

# Calculate DESeq object
# Explicit factor levels. The originals passed the grouping variable as character and let
# R's locale collation pick the reference level; in a C locale "DO", "OA" and "OW" sort
# before "control", coefficient 2 becomes control_vs_<trt>, and every log2 fold change
# flips sign silently. The stopifnot() after DESeq() guards the coefficient name.
FOA_LC_treatmentinfo$treatment <- factor(FOA_LC_treatmentinfo$treatment, levels = c("control", "OA"))

dds4 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = FOA_LC_countmatrix,
                              colData = FOA_LC_treatmentinfo,
                              design = ~ treatment)

dds4 <- DESeq(dds4)
resultsNames(dds4) # lists the coefficients
stopifnot(resultsNames(dds4)[2] == "treatment_OA_vs_control")   # guards the sign of every log2FC

PCAdata <- plotPCA(vst(dds4), intgroup = c("treatment"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100*attr(PCAdata, "percentVar")) #plot PCA of samples with all data
ggplot(PCAdata, aes(PC1, PC2, color=treatment)) + 
  geom_point(size=4, alpha = 5/10) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed()+
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Lab control", "Ocean acidification"), values = c("blue", "red"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"))

# Filtering: keep genes that have at least 10 counts across 1/3 of the samples - https://support.bioconductor.org/p/110307/
keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds4) >= 10) >= ncol(FOA_LC_countmatrix)/3
dds4_filt <- dds4[keep,]

```

### treatment control vs lab control in the foot
```{r}
# Filter data
FTC_LC_treatmentinfo <- read_delim(file.path(deg, "Foot/FTC_LC_treatmentinfo.csv"), delim = " ")

#Subset count matrix                                                                                 
FTC_LC_countmatrix <- subset(gene_count_matrix, select=(FTC_LC_treatmentinfo$sample.1))
write.table(FTC_LC_countmatrix, file = file.path(deg, "Foot/FTC_LC_countmatrix.csv"))    


# Calculate DESeq object
# Explicit factor levels. The originals passed the grouping variable as character and let
# R's locale collation pick the reference level; in a C locale "DO", "OA" and "OW" sort
# before "control", coefficient 2 becomes control_vs_<trt>, and every log2 fold change
# flips sign silently. The stopifnot() after DESeq() guards the coefficient name.
FTC_LC_treatmentinfo$day <- factor(as.character(FTC_LC_treatmentinfo$day), levels = c("0", "3"))   # day 0 = lab control is the reference

dds7 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = FTC_LC_countmatrix,
                              colData = FTC_LC_treatmentinfo,
                              design = ~ day)

dds7 <- DESeq(dds7)
resultsNames(dds7) # lists the coefficients
stopifnot(resultsNames(dds7)[2] == "day_3_vs_0")   # day-3 treatment control vs day-0 lab control

PCAdata <- plotPCA(vst(dds7), intgroup = c("day"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100*attr(PCAdata, "percentVar")) #plot PCA of samples with all data
ggplot(PCAdata, aes(PC1, PC2, color=day)) + 
  geom_point(size=4, alpha = 5/10) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed()+
  stat_ellipse(level=0.95)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Lab control", "Treatment control"), values = c("blue", "purple"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"))

# Filtering: keep genes that have at least 10 counts across 1/3 of the samples - https://support.bioconductor.org/p/110307/
keep <-  rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds7) >= 10) >= ncol(FTC_LC_countmatrix)/3
dds7_filt <- dds7[keep,]

```
